QATAR NATIONAL TEAM

SEOUL, South Korea: On a glittering evening in the heart of Seoul, Qatar’s football maestro Akram Afif and Japan’s standout Kiko Seike were crowned as the AFC Player of the Year in the men’s and women’s categories, respectively, at the prestigious AFC Annual Awards Seoul 2023. The event, held in the dynamic capital of Korea Republic, brought together the best of Asian football to honor outstanding players, coaches, and contributors. The gala night was a celebration of excellence, passion, and dedication to the sport across the continent.
